product_one_liner.value: Spacelift helps DevOps, platform and SRE teams automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration and governance across their infrastructure-as-code tools.

employee_band.notes: The careers page reports more than 130 employees; the company LinkedIn profile lists 51–200, supporting the 101–200 band.

eng_blog.notes: Two qualifying posts explain Spacelift's Kubernetes worker infrastructure and WorkerPool operator architecture. Both are by Adam Connelly, identified as a backend software engineer at Spacelift.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation includes quick starts, dashboard and notification articles, and Spacelift Flows guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable job board lists eight openings, none with a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: The Spacelift-provided AI integration identifies AWS Bedrock (Anthropic); the AI terms name Anthropic Claude models.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust center lists SOC 2 and GDPR, a SOC 2 Type II report, and a PCI-DSS SAQ-A 2025 resource. The PCI DSS evidence is a self-assessment; GDPR is a compliance claim rather than a certification.

last_funding.notes: The $51 million Series C was announced on July 10, 2025.

raised_18mo.notes: The July 2025 Series C falls within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An Enterprise Account Executive opening for remote US candidates in Texas is listed.

launched_6mo.notes: On October 29, 2026, Spacelift launched Spacelift Flows, visual workflow automation for platform and DevOps teams covering Day 2 infrastructure operations.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On May 5, 2026, Spacelift announced John Henry Archer joining as Senior Vice President of Sales and Channel and Jonah Kowall joining as Senior Vice President of Product and Design.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The subprocessor list identifies Salesforce for CRM and HubSpot for marketing. The account executive posting also names Salesforce.
